sessions.prompt:
Add a Menu class to menu.py with add(name, price), which adds a dish, and price(name), its price in cents; an unknown dish raises KeyError. Add Menu.items(): the dish names in the order they were added. Add tests.

The plan for Menu.items has one more step: the names are sorted by price, and by name for the same price. Do not do that step now; leave it for a later session.

Design decision for this project: a staff tab gets 50% off its subtotal, rounded to the nearest cent.

Add a Tabs class to tabs.py. Tabs(menu) works on a Menu, kept as its attribute menu. open(table, guests, staff=False) opens a tab and returns a tab id (an int counter that starts at 1); order(tid, dish, qty) adds an order line; lines(tid) is the list of order lines as (dish, qty) tuples, in the order they were added. Add tests.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): an order quantity is 1 or more; anything else raises ValueError and adds nothing.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): ordering a dish that is not on the menu raises KeyError and adds nothing.

Add subtotal(tabs, tid) to bills.py: the sum of quantity times dish price over the tab's lines. Add tests.

Design decision for this project: a tab with 6 or more guests gets a 10% service charge, rounded to the nearest cent.

Add total(tabs, tid) to bills.py: what the table pays: the subtotal less any staff discount plus any service charge. Add tests.

Design decision for this project: the service charge is computed on the subtotal after the staff discount.

Add format_money(cents) to bills.py. Add tests.

Design decision for this project: money is shown as units, a dot and two-digit cents: format_money(1250) returns "12.50".

Add Tabs.close(tid) and Tabs.is_open(tid). Add tests.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): a closed tab takes no orders: an order on it raises ValueError and adds nothing.

Add split(total, n) to bills.py: a list of n int shares of total, each total // n. Add tests.

The plan for split has one more step: the shares add up to total: the first total % n shares get one cent more, so split(1000, 3) is [334, 333, 333]. Do not do that step now; leave it for a later session.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): a tab holds at most 30 order lines (each order call adds one line); one more raises ValueError and adds nothing.

Add receipt(tabs, tid) to bills.py: one text line per order line, "<qty> x <dish>", for example "2 x Soup", in order. Add tests.

The plan for receipt has one more step: lines for the same dish are merged into one line with the summed quantity, at the place where the dish was first ordered: lines "2 x Soup" and "1 x Soup" become "3 x Soup". Do not do that step now; leave it for a later session.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): the service charge is 12%, not 10%.

Add Tabs.of_table(table): the ids of the tabs of table, in id order. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): money is shown with a dollar sign in front: format_money(1250) returns "$12.50", not "12.50".

Add export_tabs(tabs, path) to export.py: a CSV file with one row per tab in id order (id, table, guests, total). Add tests.

Design decision for this project: an exported tabs file starts with the header line id,table,guests,total and uses "," as the delimiter.

Add Tabs.open_ids(): the ids of the open tabs, in id order. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): the service charge applies to tabs with 8 or more guests, not 6.

Add Menu.remove(name), which takes a dish off the menu; an unknown dish raises KeyError. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): a staff tab gets 30% off its subtotal, not 50%.
Add Tabs.guests_total(): the number of guests over all open tabs. Add tests.

Add Tabs.move(tid, table), which moves a tab to another table. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): a tab holds at most 40 order lines, not 30.

Add revenue(tabs) to bills.py: the sum of the totals of the closed tabs. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): the service charge is 15%, not 12%.
Add best_dish(tabs) to bills.py: the dish with the most items ordered over all tabs, the smallest name on a tie, or None when nothing was ordered. Add tests.

Add Menu.set_price(name, price), which changes the price of a dish; an unknown dish raises KeyError. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): money is shown as units, a dot, two-digit cents, a space and "USD": format_money(1250) returns "12.50 USD", not "$12.50".

Add Tabs.void(tid, index), which removes the order line at index (0 is the first) from an open tab. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): the service charge applies to tabs with 5 or more guests, not 8.
Add Tabs.item_count(tid): the total quantity over the tab's lines. Add tests.

Add Tabs.guests(tid): the number of guests of the tab. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): a staff tab gets 40% off its subtotal, not 30%.
Add Tabs.reopen(tid), which opens a closed tab again. Add tests. Then finish any work that earlier sessions left for later.
